title: Regression Bugs Are In Your Model! Measuring, Reducing and Analyzing Regressions In NLP Model Updates
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical problem known as 'regression bugs' in NLP model updates, where a new model performs worse on certain inputs than an older model. The analysis centers on linguistic phenomena and technical mitigation strategies like knowledge distillation and model ensembling. There is no discussion or evaluation related to religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
